name: chatllm-workspace

scripts.predev: npm run check:config && npm run check:ports && npm run dev:infra
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,rag,client -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:rag" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.test: node --test scripts/check-env.test.mjs scripts/check-ports.test.mjs scripts/capacity-check.test.mjs scripts/load-smoke.test.mjs scripts/ops-check.test.mjs scripts/rag-demo-cleanup.test.mjs scripts/rag-demo-suite.test.mjs scripts/rag-smoke.test.mjs client/vite-proxy-target.test.mjs client/build-config.test.mjs client/ui-copy.test.mjs client/export-conversation.test.mjs client/chat-drafts.test.mjs && npm --prefix server run test && cd rag-service && python -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build

description: ChatLLM 是一个前后端分离的 AI 聊天与 Agentic RAG 知识工作台，支持项目空间、Markdown 知识库、混合检索、知识图谱、质量评测、Trace 和使用追踪。
